### Highlights

- Made by [AshleyDugovichStudio](https://www.etsy.com/shop/AshleyDugovichStudio)

- Materials: Ceramic, stoneware

A handmade plate for the dates you’ll always want to celebrate.

Each celebration plate is handbuilt from stoneware clay and personalized with a name, names, or meaningful date. Delicate hand-painted details follow the organically shaped edge, creating a piece that feels special enough to mark an occasion while still being made to use.

Create a birthday plate with a child’s name and birthdate, an anniversary plate with a couple’s names and wedding date, or commemorate another date that means something to you.

Personalization examples:  
happy birthday, christopher  
1.03.17

Chris & Ashley  
8.26.17

The open center leaves plenty of room for birthday cake, dessert, dinner, or whatever you’re celebrating, while the personalized details make the plate something you can bring out again year after year.

DETAILS  
• Approximately 10.5" in diameter  
• Hand built from stoneware clay  
• Personalized with a name, names, or short phrase  
• Optional special date  
• Hand-painted border and details  
• Finished in a clear glaze  
• Food safe  
• Dishwasher safe, though hand washing is recommended  
• Made individually by hand to order

Please allow 9-11 weeks for production, plus 5–7 business days for shipping.

Because every plate is handbuilt and painted individually, slight variations in shape, lettering, surface and glaze are expected and are part of what makes each piece unique.
